card.name: Linking words before surgery or exercise events
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as after, following, before, prior to and in, placed right before an event like surgery, tonsillectomy, exercise or a radiocontrast study. Seen in warning and precaution text about timing around procedures.

modes.label: After or following an event
modes.description: The word after or following introduces a procedure or exertion that precedes a risk.
modes.example: Hypoglycemia is also more likely to occur when caloric intake is deficient,<< after>> severe or prolonged exercise, or when alcohol

modes.label: Before or prior to a procedure
modes.description: The word before or prior to introduces a surgery or imaging study around which a drug is held or avoided.
modes.example: metformin hydrochloride tablets should be temporarily discontinued prior<< to>> any intravascular radiocontrast study and

modes.label: Inside a drug name
modes.description: A rare case where the pole fires inside a sedative drug name.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward naming a surgery or an activity such as drinking, and away from words about sleep or waking.
card.plain: It fires on small words like after or before when the next words will name a surgery or a strenuous event.
